description.narrative: State audit organizations (Tribunais de Contas or TCEs) report to the Legislative Branch in each Brazilian state and are the entities responsible for performing financial and operational audits of budget execution and the quality of government expenditures. The overarching development objective of the grant would be to strengthen TCEs thereby adding another tool to those being used to improve the quality, efficiency and effectiveness of public expenditure. To achieve this objective, the grant would seek to strengthen selected more developed TCEs to (i) improve their audit and control over sub-national expenditures and (ii) leverage their capabilities to provide cost-effective training, TA and knowledge transfer to less-advanced state audit organizations. The grant would not provide sufficient resources to meet the needs of all TCEs. However, it would take an x-ray of the current institutional and technical capabilities of potentially all TCEs, provide them an opportunity to assess and develop strategies to address their key development gaps, and for the less advanced TCEs, participate in limited training and TA activities and begin the process of strengthening the external audit of sub-national public expenditures in their states. The development objective of the grant would be to strengthen three more-developed state audit organizations (Tribunal de Contas or TCEs) to (i) improve their audit and control over sub-national expenditures and (ii) leverage their capabilities to provide cost-effective training, TA and knowledge transfer to other, lesser-developed TCEs.
